semantics.evidence: Original problem explicitly specifies a combinational circuit and 4-input AND, OR, XOR gates.
semantics.out_and: 1 iff all four binary input bits are 1
semantics.out_or: 1 iff at least one binary input bit is 1
semantics.out_xor: 1 iff an odd number of binary input bits are 1
semantics.timing: Continuously responds to input changes; no clock or cycle latency. Testbench samples after combinational settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No state or initialization specified; outputs depend on current inputs.

numeric.interpretation: Individual Boolean bits; XOR is parity, not arithmetic sum.

verification.oracle: Enumerate all 16 binary vectors; independently count set bits and compare count==4, count!=0, count%2==1.
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait 1 ns before comparison.
verification.coverage: Ascending and descending exhaustive binary sweeps; supplementary X/Z gate propagation checks.
verification.failure: Case-inequality comparisons with $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original problem does not explicitly define X/Z behavior.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use standard SystemVerilog gate reduction semantics; X/Z checks are supplemental, not additional binary functional requirements.
